# STEN Engineering Skills

Skills are deterministic review playbooks. The auditor selects only the skills relevant to the change.

- ui-visual: premium B2B visual consistency, responsive layout, accessibility, no glass/aurora.
- root-cause: reproduce → trace → isolate → fix root cause → regression check.
- api-contract: UI/API/OpenAPI/backend contract consistency; no invented endpoints.
- finance-integrity: PLAN/FACT/CONFIRMED chain, missing ≠ zero, deterministic formulas.
- sten-yandexgpt: YandexGPT-only production AI; provider credentials stay server-side.
- security-secrets: secret scanning, auth boundaries, unsafe client-side credentials, debug leakage.
- deploy-smoke: typecheck/build/dist/routes/MIME/static hosting smoke checks.
- mobile-ux: iPhone safe-area, touch targets, keyboard/viewport and compact navigation.

Rule: a skill may report a blocker but must not invent evidence. If backend/cloud state is unavailable, mark it UNVERIFIED and state the exact external check required.

- org-scope: projects, branches, restaurants, departments, scope isolation and aggregation rules.
- finance-calculator: deterministic P&L calculator, missing-data safety, aggregation and margins.
- document-intelligence: Excel/PDF/DOCX/image extraction, analysis-before-save, normalized XLSX.
- data-provenance: trace every displayed/derived number to source and formula.
